comment: SKF.cpp:68 calls configInput(OUTPUT_OUTPUT, "Filter") where configOutput was meant. OUTPUT_OUTPUT is zero, so the name lands on input 0 — the FM jack, whose own name from :65 is overwritten — and the OUT jack is left with no name at all. Rack therefore shows Filter when you hover FM and nothing when you hover OUT. Confirmed in the census: SKF is the only model in the plugin whose inputs[0] is named Filter and whose outputs[0] name is empty. Resonance is sallenkey.cpp:236, res = 4.0f * Resonance. The core also carries an SK_HIGHPASS_MODE and two further integration methods (SK_SEMI_IMPLICIT_EULER, SK_PREDICTOR_CORRECTOR) that the panel and menu never reach.
